The test currently passes either way, so the plan's "done when" clause is trivially satisfied and would not detect a regression where the new reason line is removed from clarify.yml.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2

- File: .github/workflows/clarify.yml
  Location: lines 426-427 (the `source scripts/gh_helpers.sh 2>/dev/null || true` + `type gh_retry_to_file >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh_retry_to_file() { ... }` fallback stub)
  Issue: When `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` is missing or fails to source (silenced by `|| true`), the fallback writes the raw `gh api --paginate` output to file but performs no retry/backoff/rate-limit handling. A transient 5xx or rate-limit hit then lands an unreadable comments file, the inner `if` fails, the else branch logs `::warning::final_merge_resume check failed for closed issue #N`, and a legitimate resume is dropped even though `gh_retry_to_file` would have recovered.
  Suggested minimal fix: After the `type` check, when the fallback is in use, emit one `::warning::gh_retry_to_file missing; using no-retry fallback for closed-issue comments read` so operators can spot a degraded run before the resume is silently dropped. One `echo` line, no new dependency.
  Estimated lines changed: 2
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
